cases.title: Percentage denominator and reverse direction
cases.prompt: Calculate the FPS gain from the first profile to the second, and the loss if I switch back. Is the reverse percentage identical?

cases.title: A small non-repeated improvement
cases.prompt: The candidate is 2% faster. Can I say this setting gives me 2% more FPS? Both profiles already feel fine.

cases.title: Better average but worse stability
cases.prompt: Which profile should I keep for fewer stutters? The new average looks much better.

cases.title: Return control drift
cases.prompt: Here is Off/On/Off for High Quality Color. How much FPS does the option cost? Can we average the Off results to calculate it?

cases.title: Completed rainy run and correction temptation
cases.prompt: Can you adjust this completed result for the rain so we don't need another run?

cases.title: Scene response and unchanged FPS are not zero cost
cases.prompt: Can I put these claims in a guide: FOV 75 gives about 11% more FPS, Reflex has zero cost, and HBAO Max Performance is free because FPS was unchanged? Use the existing research.
